label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: Every country team emails that their invoices are urgent, but there's no set priority order so I waste time asking around. Because of this, I'm missing my daily SAP quota by about 20 invoices.
What would help establish a priority order for the invoices?
A simple priority order from my lead, or having just one designated person who decides, would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: Unclear invoice priorities cause wasted time and missed daily quotas. [ROLE_CLARITY] "Every country team emails that their invoices are urgent, but there's no set priority order so I waste time asking around."
